title: New workspace

storages.local: Only on this computer, without an account.
storages.cloud: In the account at WireCloud, shareable with others.

masterRequired: Without the master password the workspaces cannot be opened.
import: Or take it from an export file …
vaultsHint: Where connections in this workspace can get their credentials from. Both can be left empty and added later in the workspace settings.
serverHelper: Empty means bitwarden.com; Vaultwarden works the same.
accountHint: You sign in once per backend, not per workspace. If the sign-in or the master password is missing, you will be asked for it on "Next".
signInOrCreate: Sign in or create an account
verificationSent: The mail is on its way to {email}. After clicking the link in it, check again here.
notVerified: Your email address is not verified yet. Until then the backend does not show any invitations here.
createNewHint: A new organization on this backend.
allAdded: All workspaces of this account are already in the rail.
noneYet: There is no workspace for this account yet.
managedHint: You create companies in WireCloud and invite members there. As soon as you have access, the workspace appears here.
pasteInvitation: Paste an invitation link from a mail
pasteInvitationHint: The backend only shows open invitations to accounts with a verified email address — they can be accepted anyway.
